import hashlib,json,os,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(__file__).parent;q=p.parent/'integer-decimal-cast-2cc3024';variant=sys.argv[1];assert variant in ['before','refined','gated']
source=q/'arrow-cast' if variant=='before' else p/'arrow-cast'
if variant=='refined':
 f=source/'src/cast/integer_decimal_buffer.rs';f.write_bytes((p/'refined-integer_decimal_buffer.rs').read_bytes())
elif variant=='gated':(source/'src/cast/integer_decimal_buffer.rs').write_bytes((p/'gated-integer_decimal_buffer.rs').read_bytes())
# Standalone copies share a relative Cargo source identity. Force the root
# crate to rebuild, then require a non-fresh compiler artifact before linking.
(source/'src/cast/mod.rs').touch()
cmd=['cargo','build','--release','--offline','--locked','--manifest-path',str(source/'Cargo.toml'),'--message-format=json','-j','3']
with (p/f'kernel-{variant}-cargo.jsonl').open('w') as out,(p/f'kernel-{variant}-cargo.log').open('w') as err:subprocess.run(cmd,env=os.environ|{'CARGO_TARGET_DIR':str(p/'target')},stdout=out,stderr=err,check=True)
artifacts=[json.loads(line) for line in (p/f'kernel-{variant}-cargo.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()];artifacts=[r for r in artifacts if r.get('reason')=='compiler-artifact'];libraries={}
for name in ['arrow_array','arrow_buffer','arrow_cast','arrow_schema']:
 matches=[r for r in artifacts if r['target']['name']==name and 'lib' in r['target']['kind']];assert len(matches)==1,(name,len(matches));r=matches[0];files=[x for x in r['filenames'] if x.endswith('.rlib')];assert len(files)==1
 if name=='arrow_cast':
  assert not r['fresh'],r
  saved=p/f'libarrow_cast-current-{variant}.rlib';saved.write_bytes(Path(files[0]).read_bytes());files=[str(saved)]
 libraries[name]={'path':files[0],'sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(files[0]).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'package_id':r['package_id'],'features':r['features'],'profile':r['profile']}
assert str(source) in libraries['arrow_cast']['package_id']
cmd=['rustc','--edition=2024','-O',str(p/'kernel-bench.rs'),'-L',f'dependency={p}/target/release/deps','-o',str(p/f'kernel-current-{variant}')]
for name,entry in libraries.items():cmd+=['--extern',f'{name}={entry["path"]}']
with (p/f'kernel-current-{variant}-build.log').open('w') as log:subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
record={'variant':variant,'source_mod_sha256':hashlib.sha256((source/'src/cast/mod.rs').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'source_reuse_sha256':hashlib.sha256((source/'src/cast/integer_decimal_buffer.rs').read_bytes()).hexdigest() if variant!='before' else None,'libraries':libraries,'command':cmd,'binary_sha256':hashlib.sha256((p/f'kernel-current-{variant}').read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
(p/f'kernel-current-{variant}-build.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n');print(variant,record['binary_sha256'],flush=True)

import datetime,json,os,statistics,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(__file__).parent;old=p.parent/'integer-decimal-cast-2cc3024';outdir=p/'performance-default';outdir.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
variants=['before','after'];order=['before','after','after','before']*6
ids=['div_i16_literal_ansifalse','div_integer_ansitrue','div_i32_column_ansitrue','plain_projection_ansitrue','no_division_ansitrue','round_decimal_ansitrue','div_decimal_ansitrue','correlated_max_ansitrue']
checks={v:{r['id']:r for r in json.loads((old/'after-subquery-check.json').read_text())['results']} for v in variants}
env=os.environ.copy();assert not any(k.startswith(('MALLOC_','GLIBC_','LD_PRELOAD','DECIMAL_BENCH_')) for k in env)
runs=[]
for index,v in enumerate(order):
 for case in ids[index%2:]+ids[:index%2]:
  out=outdir/f'{index:02}-{v}-{case}';out.mkdir()
  for name in ['control','ack']:os.mkfifo(out/name)
  cmd=['perf','stat','--delay=-1',f'--control=fifo:{out}/control,{out}/ack','--json-output','-o',str(out/'counters.jsonl'),'-e','{instructions:u,cycles:u},task-clock:u,context-switches:u,cpu-migrations:u,page-faults:u','--','taskset','-c','2',str(old/'after-bench' if v=='before' else p/'after-bench'),str(out/'capture.json'),'subqueries',case]
  started=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.UTC).isoformat();r=subprocess.run(cmd,env=env|{'DECIMAL_BENCH_PERF_DIR':str(out),'DECIMAL_BENCH_PERF_PHASE':'execution'},capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=120)
  cap=json.loads((out/'capture.json').read_text());assert len(cap['results'])==1;row=cap['results'][0]
  for k,value in checks[v][case].items():assert row[k]==value,(v,case,k)
  counters=[json.loads(x) for x in (out/'counters.jsonl').read_text().splitlines() if x.startswith('{')]
  assert len(counters)==6 and all(x['pcnt-running']==100 for x in counters)
  assert r.stderr.count('Events enabled')==1 and len(row['samples_ms'])==9
  c={x['event']:float(x['counter-value']) for x in counters}
  run={'variant':v,'index':index,'case':case,'started_utc':started,'command':cmd,'capture':cap,'counters':counters,'stderr':r.stderr,'median_ms':statistics.median(row['samples_ms']),'execution_sum_ms':sum(row['samples_ms']),'page_faults':c['page-faults:u']};runs.append(run)
  print(index,v,case,round(run['median_ms'],3),run['page_faults'],flush=True)
 (p/'performance-default.json').write_text(json.dumps({'order':order,'cases':ids,'runs':runs},indent=2)+'\n')
print('All performance runs passed',flush=True)

method.kernel_timing: Supplementary standalone Rust cast benchmark; separate compiler feature set is recorded. One or four workers, 128 batches each, output dropped per batch or all retained until sample end. CPU 2 or CPUs 2,3,4,5; barriers align worker samples; median of per-sample maximum worker elapsed. Six fresh processes per variant/case. These timings are not pooled with SQL timings.
method.memory: Four fresh processes per variant/case; /proc snapshots at existing FIFO markers, excluded from timing comparison. Four extra mapping probes investigate the executable RSS increase.
method.tracing: Eight target runs per variant, separate from untraced performance. Count brk/mmap/munmap/madvise strictly between FIFO marker writes.
method.scope: Warm repeated execution on this Linux x86_64/glibc host; no claim about all allocators, batch sizes, cold starts, platforms or concurrent sessions.

executable_mappings.scope: Four follow-up memory probes of the wrapped SMALLINT target, excluded from timing. Executable mappings account for the observed clean-file RSS difference; an exact layout or read-ahead cause is not established.

initial_zeroed_buffer_kernel.scope: Each sample casts 128 batches of 8192 Int64 rows to Decimal128(38,6) per worker, with two warmups and nine samples. Stream drops each output; retain holds all outputs until the end of the sample, including their destruction in elapsed time. Barriers align worker samples; each process contributes the median of per-sample maximum worker elapsed times. Worker creation and input generation are outside timing. No SQL planning.

excluded_trials.reason: Both later microbenchmark builds hard-coded the earlier runtime rlib, while standalone cargo builds emitted a different primary-package artifact. Their binaries are byte-identical to the initial prototype, so these runs do not evaluate the modified source. Initial prototype timing remains valid for its saved prototype source. Corrected builds obtain all rlib paths from Cargo compiler-artifact messages.
excluded_trials.build_provenance_correction: Standalone copies using the same target also reused the primary-package artifact because Cargo treated relative root sources as the same identity. Corrected standalone builds touch src/cast/mod.rs, require a non-fresh compiler artifact, copy the emitted rlib before linking, and assert distinct library and benchmark hashes. No timing from the identical before/refined binaries is included.

preservation.restored_source_mtimes: Changed scratch files are restored with current mtimes so Cargo rechecks their contents on the next build.

findings: Default-allocator target high-fault processes fall from 10/24 to 0/24. Final SMALLINT/BIGINT medians are 2.181/2.129 ms.

Final target traces have 0-2 brk calls and no mmap/munmap/madvise calls in execution; the baseline slow traces have 2,304 brk calls. The result removes per-batch heap churn, not every possible allocation or page fault.

The simpler ungated cache slows four-worker retained-output microbenchmarks by 13.65%. Limiting managed live results to one changes that case by -0.65%, while the one-worker stream case improves 32.51%.

All 3,076 SQL observations preserve values, types, plans and failure stages; agreement with Spark remains 2,950, with 126 known differences. Four error payloads select a different invalid row; repeated tiny-batch captures preserve the causes and stages.
Target private dirty medians change by +36/-2 KiB. Whole-process RSS is higher, primarily in clean executable mappings. These measurements do not equate a 256 KiB idle bound with a process RSS bound.
limitations: The cache is process-wide within this Arrow cast implementation, not per query. It retains up to 256 KiB of idle value-buffer capacity plus metadata, outside an individual query memory reservation. Live arrays and ordinary allocator retention are additional.

Only the proven infallible integer-to-Decimal branch and 64-256 KiB output buffers participate. Other sizes, incompatible cached sizes/alignment and overlapping managed output lifetimes use ordinary allocation. Concurrency can reduce the reuse benefit.

A custom-owned output supports normal reads, clones, slices and release on another thread, but Arrow Buffer::into_mutable/into_vec cannot reclaim it directly. Downstream consumers requiring mutable ownership may copy.

Whole-process RSS is 3,166-7,018 KiB higher across the measured controls/targets. Extra target mapping probes locate most of this in clean executable pages; the executable grows by 96,056 bytes. The exact layout/read-ahead cause is not established.
The unchanged wrapped Decimal projection median is +0.83%; other control timings and outliers remain recorded. No universal zero-overhead or all-platform claim is made.
This optional patch has not been enabled in the default project, committed, pushed or submitted upstream. The 126 existing Spark differences remain open.
